requirements.text: **Location:** San Francisco, CA. This is an in\-office role five days per week.
* 2\+ years of experience building and maintaining backend applications, services, or data\-intensive systems
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, testing, debugging, and operational reliability
* A data\-oriented approach to solving problems and measuring whether a system is working
* Experience working with APIs, databases, data pipelines, or distributed systems
* The ability to navigate ambiguous problems, break them into manageable pieces, and deliver iteratively
* Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and non\-technical teams
* A quality\-focused mindset and an interest in building systems that make difficult\-to\-measure outcomes more rigorous
* Experience with machine learning, applied AI, or AI\-enabled products
* Familiarity with model evaluation, experimentation, recommendation systems, or ranking systems
* Experience with annotation, data\-labeling, tasking, or workflow\-orchestration platforms
* Experience building developer platforms, internal tools, or extensible APIs
* Familiarity with MCP, agentic systems, or AI\-native development tools
* Experience working in a fast\-moving startup or similarly ambiguous environment
